name: Inbox
tagline: Pings only for mail needing action today; everything else lands in a digest.
description: Email interruption is mostly noise, so this filters it: a message gets a ping only when it genuinely needs action from you today, and the rest collects into a batched digest you read on your own rhythm. It is read-only by design and never sends anything on your behalf, so the inbox stays entirely under your control.
author: cu30rry_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
